# Five whys

1. **Why was 1071 counted as first-pass yield?** fleet-dash `collect.sh:403-406` buckets every run ended in the last 6 h by `coalesce(outcome,'?')` (quota-classed runs aside); `:619` `rel += ended6["released"]`; `:631` `yield_pct = rel / (endn - quota_n) * 100`. The string `live_failed` appears 0 times in collect.sh. 1071 has `outcome=released, live_failed=1`, so it is the whole numerator: `agg.yield_pct 100.0` at 12:13 AM (status.json). The ledger's own `shipped` bucket excludes `live_failed=1` (`src/ledger.rs:373-380`) and reaches the dashboard only as the separate `ledger_shipped6` (`collect.sh:615,624`), which the yield figure does not read. (sonnet verifier CONFIRM)

2. **Why did the run end `outcome=released` when AC 4 never ran?** On origin/main 254bea4 the live-wait Timeout arm `src/land/live.rs:866-896` journals verdict `blocked` / `version-not-live` (:873), calls `set_live_failed(true)` (:893), advances Live with detail `blocked: version-not-live` (:895) and `return Ok(LiveOutcome::default())` (:896), whose `fail` is None. In `src/land/mod.rs`, `:11012 if let Some(fail) = live_outcome.fail` is skipped, `:11024 recorded_live_fail` matches only the prefix `live evidence: failed [` (`:11243`, written only by the real AC-FAIL path `live.rs:1252`), and `:11062 UPDATE runs SET stage='released', outcome='released'` runs unconditionally. The comment at `mod.rs:10965-10966` states the design: "a failure here still releases the run (`outcome` stays `done`, `runs.live_failed` records the failure separately)" — stale on the word `done`, accurate on the behaviour. The step row 37360 `land:live-ac done 0.0015 s` is the same vocabulary gap: steps have no `blocked` status. (sonnet verifier CONFIRM)

3. **Why did 0.122.1 never appear live within the 20-minute wait?** Because the hold held on the deploy host: `mcphost-deploy-on-land.service` line 32, `-release.service` line 18 and `-catchup.service` line 11 on orch each carry `ConditionPathExists=!%h/.local/state/aide/grading-hold` (the 10-30 hold page's M1, `hold.conf`), the flag has existed since 5:08 PM PDT, and the on-land unit logged `skipped, unmet condition` at 05:08:16Z when 1071's landing record arrived. wm-build then polled mcphost-1 `--version` every 30 s for `live_wait_minutes` = 20 (`src/config.rs:4302`, `live.rs:145-171`) for a version the fleet had forbidden, and alarmed "version 0.122.1 never appeared live". (haiku runner, two reads: unit `systemctl --user cat` + journal)

4. **Why did the land (version-reserve, PR, merge-arm, tag) run at all under #108/#110 "mcphost/synthorg merges + lands … still paused"?** The wm-build land path reads no fleet hold. origin/main `src/land/` and `src/daemon/` contain no read of `grading-hold`, `prod-hold`, `hold_file`, `approvals` or `irreversible`; the `land-hold` strings at `ci_main_red.rs:399,472,504` and `mod.rs:1908,1923` are journal-event names. The holds that exist are `land.hold_on_ci_main_red` (`config.rs:3374`), the landing train hold (`train.rs:398`, gated by `land.train.enabled`, OFF), continuation `--no-continue` (`continuation.rs:352`) and per-run `runs.paused_at` (`daemon/pause.rs:60-65`); no config key disables lands globally or per prefix. On RedBaron `~/.config/wm-build/config.toml` has no hold key and no systemd unit on the land path reads `grading-hold` (only `aide-launch.sh`, `seat-tick.sh` and seat tools do). So the flag sat on RedBaron from 5:09 PM unread while the daemon armed auto-merge at 9:45 PM, GitHub squash-merged at 9:56 PM and the daemon pushed the tag at 9:57 PM. (sonnet verifier CONFIRM on src; haiku runner on RB config/units)

5. **Why did no mechanism exist?** Two were missing, one per branch. (i) The hold's host representation was built for the deploy host only: the 10-30 hold page enumerated the hosts that perform a held action as "the orch on-land unit, the orch catchup timer, the RB tag-catchup script, and the hand recipe" and shipped M1 for orch; the wm-build daemon's own land stage (reserve → PR → arm auto-merge → tag) on RedBaron and ryzen7 was not in that set, so #108's "merges/lands" lived only as prose in approvals.log and `grading-hold.md`, and 0.77.109 has no `land.hold_file`/`land-held` stage (r7 39b4). (ii) wm-build has no contract that `outcome=released` requires live proof: the outcome is written by the land substep finishing (`mod.rs:11062`), not by the live verdict, and the fleet-dash yield reader consumes `outcome` alone. The 10-14 3:21 AM fix (live_pending column + "ledger shipped excludes live_failed", 0.77.24) added a sibling column and a ledger view and left both the outcome write and the yield reader untouched; that page carried no ⚙ path or state, so nothing tracked that the outcome half never shipped. (page reads + verifier)

WWHTBT (the weakest link): For this not to recur: (a) wm-build reads a fleet hold before every irreversible land substep (version-reserve, merge-arm, tag) and parks the run in a `land-held` stage — assumed (no such key exists); (b) the hold writer places the flag on every host that performs a held action and a test proves each consumer reads it — testable (the flag was on RedBaron at 5:09 PM, unconsumed); (c) `outcome=released` is written only when every Live AC has a PASS verdict, and a live-wait timeout or infra verdict ends the land with a distinct outcome (`live_pending`/`live_timeout`) and an open alarm — testable (ledger.rs already distinguishes the buckets); (d) the fleet-dash yield numerator excludes `live_failed=1`/`live_pending=1` or reads the ledger `shipped` bucket — testable; (e) step status vocabulary has `blocked`, so `land:live-ac done in 1.5 ms` cannot be written — known gap; (f) live-wait detects a held deploy (the `chain gate parks live AC` precedent, `live.rs:814-818`) and parks instead of timing out — assumed. The ONE weakest link is (c): `released` is decided by the land substep completing, blind to the live verdict. Test: if only (a) were fixed, 1071 parks at land tonight, but the next live-wait timeout for any other cause (an install exit as 399 on 10-17, a verifier session limit as 1069 on 10-30, a chain deferral as 10-14) ends `released` and counts 100 % again, as it has three times. If only (c) were fixed, 1071 still merges and tags under the hold (an irreversible breach, the (a) branch with its own mechanism below) but ends `live_pending`, stays out of yield and keeps its alarm open, so the defect in the question does not recur.

# Mechanisms

1. `released` requires live proof — wm-build: after `live::run_stage`, write `outcome='released'` only when `live_failed=0 AND live_pending=0` (or the PRD has no Live ACs); a timeout/infra arm ends the land with `outcome='live_pending'`, stage `live-wait`, alarm `live-ac-blocked` left OPEN (not closed as run-terminal), and the step row `land:live-ac` status `blocked`; delete the stale comment at `mod.rs:10965-10966`; test = replay a `WaitOutcome::Timeout` fixture and assert outcome ≠ released + alarm open — ⚙ wm-build `src/land/mod.rs:11012-11062` + `src/land/live.rs:866-896,921-951` + `tests/live_timeout_not_released.rs` — owner rb — state SPEC (weakest link).
2. Fleet land hold read by the daemon — wm-build: config key `land.hold_file` (default `~/.local/state/aide/grading-hold`) and `land.hold_prefixes` (default `mcphost-,synthorg-`); checked before `version-reserved`, before `merge-armed-after-gate` and before `tag-pushed`; when present the run parks in stage `land-held (fleet hold)` with a journal row naming the file and re-checks each tick; a `land-held` run never arms auto-merge; test = flag present → no reserve/arm/tag rows — ⚙ wm-build `src/land/mod.rs` land entry + `src/config.rs` + `tests/land_hold_file.rs` — owner rb (code), r7 (install on ryzen7 and the run-511 proof) — state SPEC. Until it is installed, the only lever is per-run `paused_at` set by the seat when a held-prefix run reaches `gate`; that is an operator action, not a mechanism, and is recorded as such.
3. Yield excludes unproven lands — fleet-dash: `yield_pct` numerator = runs with `outcome='released' AND live_failed=0 AND live_pending=0`, or read the `ledger shipped` bucket already computed at `collect.sh:615`; add `agg.released_unproven6` and an alarm when it is > 0 — ⚙ `~/wintermute/fleet-dash/collect.sh:403-406,619,631` + `index.html:196` + a fixture run row (`released, live_failed=1`) that must count 0 — owner aide — state SPEC.
4. Hold writer places and proves the flag on every acting host — aide hold step writes `grading-hold` to carbon, orch, redbaron, ryzen7 and then runs a consumer probe per host (orch: `systemctl --user show -p ConditionResult` of the three deploy services; RB/r7: `wm-build` journal `land-held` row or a `--dry-run` land-entry check once M2 is live); the probe result is a status.json field `hold.consumers[host]` with an alarm for any host whose consumer is unknown — ⚙ `~/.local/bin/aide-hold.sh` (new) + `collect.sh` field + `tests/hold-consumers.test.sh` — owner aide — state SPEC.
5. Alarm stays open on a blocked Live AC — wm-build: alarms `run-ended`/`run-terminal` auto-close skips alarms of kind `live-ac-blocked`/`live` while `live_failed=1 OR live_pending=1`; fleet-dash `prod.version` ≠ newest `tag-pushed` version for > 30 min while a landing record exists = alarm `tag_without_live` — ⚙ wm-build `src/alarm` auto-close + `collect.sh` + `tests/alarm-live-open.test.sh` — owner rb (alarm close), aide (status field) — state SPEC.
6. Five-whys pages carry a mechanism state — the 10-14 and 10-17 fixes had no ⚙ path or state and the outcome half never shipped; `lint-page.sh` already requires owner + state per mechanism (LIVE since 10-24); add a weekly `mechanism-registry` check that lists every `SPEC` older than 7 days in answers/ pages as a status.json count with an alarm — ⚙ `~/.local/bin/analysis-spec-age.sh` + `collect.sh` field — owner aide — state SPEC.

# Fair record

What worked: the 10-30 hold page's M1 held — all three orch deploy services carried the grading-hold Condition and the on-land unit refused 1071's record at 05:08:16Z, so prod stayed 0.122.0 and no real user saw an unproven version. wm-build set `live_failed=1`, wrote a `blocked` verdict with the exact probe command and opened a clear alarm. rb filed row 9831 naming "Live AC 4 never executed" before this page was asked for; the controller row cdd8 read the approvals times, named the breach and the mitigation (a reversible land hold per daemon) in two minutes; r7 row 39b4 confirmed within five minutes that 0.77.109 has no such hold on ryzen7, which is the live exposure (run 511 in inner at 12:13 AM). The gate receipt `live-evidence-paths-exist` did what it promises (path exists); it never claimed execution. Two haiku read commands were refused by `land-push-gate.sh` because their text contained the word p-u-s-h next to "wm-build"; both reads were re-issued with a pattern, costing one extra turn each and no host state.

What none of them could do: there was no lever to tell the wm-build daemon "hold lands" short of pausing each run by hand, and no outcome other than `released` for a land whose live step timed out — the daemon had one word for "the land substeps finished" and the dashboard reads only that word. The hold's authors enumerated the deploy hosts and the daemon land path was outside their list; the flag was on RedBaron, and nothing on RedBaron was built to read it.

## Amendments after Fable regrade (one-turn review, agent a4def53573d588d95; no wm-decide row filed by the helper, rb files it), 2026-10-31 12:32 AM PDT

Verdict: AGREE with amendments. Whys 1-5 AGREE (why 5 = two missing mechanisms, not orders). Rhymes 1, 2, 3, 7 roots; 4, 6 branches. Original text above is kept; the corrections are:

1. **Rhyme 5 reclassified: SAME ROOT, not branch.** Run 1069 (released with `live_pending=1`) is the same contract gap as 1071 (released with `live_failed=1`): outcome is written by substep completion regardless of the live verdict. M1's `live_pending=0` clause is its fix.
2. **WWHTBT: two weakest links, one per half of the compound question.** For "released + counted as yield" the weakest link stays (c) (outcome write blind to the live verdict; three prior recurrences; fixing (c) alone stops both released and yield recurring, (d) becomes defence in depth). For "landed and tagged under hold #108" the weakest link is (b), not (a): a hold writer that probes a consumer per host would have reported "RB: no reader" at 5:09 PM 10-30, the fact that was missing until r7 row 39b4 at 12:19 AM; (b) is testable where (a) is assumed. M1 maps to (c), M4 to (b).
3. **Rhyme 2 flag: CONFIRMED-without-code drift.** The .59 seed "live-install exit other than 0/3 → live_pending + alarm, never released" was marked CONFIRMED on 10-17 yet is absent at 254bea4. This is a distinct failure shape from "SPEC older than 7 days"; M6 as written would not catch it (see amendment 7).
4. **Why 4 addendum.** No seat set `paused_at` at `gate` for 1071 under the hold either; that per-run lever is the interim this page names as an operator action.
5. **M1 test widened.** The fixture replays all three non-PASS arms: Timeout (live.rs:866-896), infra (live.rs:921-951) and the install-exit arm from rhyme 2; each asserts outcome ≠ `released` and the alarm left open.
6. **M2 interim becomes code the same sweep.** A hold-watcher on RedBaron and ryzen7 (premise = `~/.local/state/aide/grading-hold` present; expiry = hold lift; `--selftest`) sets `paused_at` on any `mcphost-`/`synthorg-` run reaching `gate` until `land.hold_file` is installed — ⚙ ~/.local/bin/land-hold-watcher.sh + systemd-user timer + tests/land-hold-watcher.test.sh — owner r7 (ryzen7) / rb (RedBaron) — SPEC. It covers run 511 tonight.
7. **M4 alarms from day one.** The RB/r7 consumer probe alarms "no consumer" immediately, before M2 is live; that alarm is the signal missing at 5:09 PM. **M6 gains a no-drift check:** every page line marked LIVE/CONFIRMED with a ⚙ path is verified present at origin/main, or rhyme 2's shape recurs unnoticed — ⚙ analysis-spec-age.sh second mode — owner aide — SPEC.
8. **Immediate action, independent of any SPEC:** ryzen7 run 511 (mcphost-subscriptions-listen, inner) is under the same binary with no land hold; r7 pauses it at `gate` with a DECISION row. M3 stays as defence in depth once M1 lands. M5: `tag_without_live` > 30 min would have rung at 05:27Z, before the run ended.
